verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community comment on a redesign. It describes the README rendering with headings and <pre> blocks, which implies formatted README display, though it complains about the narrow, cramped layout. Nothing in the pack documents Markdown support itself. missing for 10: first-party documentation of Markdown support, rendering in issues and comments, syntax-highlighted code blocks, independent corroboration beyond a single dated comment.
